resources.string: Pair with your PC
On your PC, open PocketPC (tray icon) and click \"Pair new phone…\". Then scan the QR code it shows.
Scan QR code
Point the camera at the QR code in PocketPC on your PC
No camera? Type the PC address and code instead:
PC address, e.g. 192.168.1.20
Code, e.g. 7K3M-Q9XR-T2HB
Pair
Add a PC without PocketPC (classic Moonlight)
Pair with %1$s?
This lets this phone stream from %1$s and control it. Only continue if you opened the pairing window on that PC yourself.
That QR code isn\'t a PocketPC pairing code.
Enter the PC address and the code shown on the PC.
Paired with %1$s. Pick a game or the desktop to start streaming.
Connecting to your PC…
Pairing securely…
Setting up streaming (this takes a few seconds)…
Couldn\'t reach the PC. Make sure the phone is on the same Wi-Fi (or Tailscale) and PocketPC is running on the PC.\n\n(%1$s)
This phone couldn\'t create its security key (%1$s).
That code isn\'t right. Check the code shown on the PC and try again.
Codes have 12 letters and numbers, like 7K3M-Q9XR-T2HB.
Too many wrong codes. Click \"New code\" on the PC and try again.
The PC isn\'t accepting new phones right now. In PocketPC on the PC, click \"Pair new phone…\" first.
The PC at this address couldn\'t prove it is the one showing the code. Check the address, or scan the QR code instead.
This PC no longer trusts this phone. Pair it again.
The streaming server didn\'t match the PC you paired with, so streaming was not set up. Try again on your home network.
Pairing failed (%1$s).
Paired with %1$s, but Sunshine isn\'t installed there yet. Run the PocketPC installer on the PC, then pair again to stream.
Paired with %1$s, but Sunshine (the streaming service) didn\'t answer. Make sure it\'s running, then pair again.
Paired with %1$s, but PocketPC on the PC still needs your Sunshine login. Open PocketPC on the PC, finish the Sunshine step, then pair again.
Paired with %1$s, but streaming setup didn\'t finish (%2$s). Pair again to retry.
